text:
Mina: hey team, first day! got my 14" MBP and trying to finish onboarding. Company Portal shows "Enrollment: pending" and when I tried to turn on FileVault I got an error code 4922. macOS 13.6.2. Need to install Rosetta + brew. Who can grant a short admin window?

it-support: welcome Mina! can you run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status` and paste results? sometimes the portal needs a re-accept.

Mina: `profiles: There are no configuration profiles installed.` and `fdesetup status: FileVault is Off`. UI shows FileVault enabling though.

ops-jay: I can push a temporary admin token (45-60m). We do not give permanent admin. Want me to trigger it now?

Mina: yes please, 45 minutes is fine. I'll just install Rosetta, Homebrew, and Docker.

ops-jay: pushing enrollment + admin now. You should get a macOS notification from Company Portal. After accepting, run: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` and then the Homebrew installer. Run `sudo -v` to confirm admin.

MDM Bot: Enrollment re-triggered by ops-jay for device serial ending in ABCD7890. Admin token valid 45 minutes.

ops-jay: looks green on our side. If FileVault still shows errors after enrollment finish we'll escalate to imaging.

Mina: got the prompt and admin, installed Rosetta and brew. `fdesetup status` now returns "FileVault is On". Rebooting to ensure everything is clean.

Lina: small note — while FileVault encrypts you may see high CPU/disk for a few hours. Spotlight reindex is expected. Also if you need certain brew packages allowed (e.g., some DB clients) ping #devx.

people-ops: welcome Mina :tada: we'll send calendar invites for intros.

Mina: thanks all! labeling this resolved for now :rocket:
